title: Bijectivity of the prescribed scalar-extension twist map on the complete standard chart
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sfb-proj-scalar-extension-twist-chart, for every positive-degree homogeneous f, the prescribed twist map is bijective on sections over the complete standard open D_+(psi(f)).

source.place: Tag 01N2 (lemma-base-change-map-proj), clause (3), standard-open calculation; Tag 01MY (lemma-morphism-proj), localized graded-module formula

proof.text: Apply the injective half of the complete-chart fraction comparison to the same data. The hypotheses hβψ and hgraded identify the shifted homogeneous pieces after scalar extension, while hη identifies the resulting map with η on chart sections.

Apply the surjective half of the complete-chart fraction comparison to the same data. The affine tensor-section comparison and homogeneous localization equivalence provide a preimage for every target chart section, and hη identifies that comparison with η.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01N2 clause (3), complete standard-open proof, reduced to injective and surjective chart components
